result.instructions: Tools for Judge.me, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many reviews did our store get this month, and what is the average rating?"; "Show me the 1-star reviews from the last week so I can reply to them."; "Who wrote the review with id 4521, and what is their email?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Judge.me data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run judgeme_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run judgeme_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run judgeme_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. judgeme_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: judgeme_list_reviews
tools.title: List reviews
tools.description: List the store's product and store reviews, newest first, with rating, body, reviewer and product fields. Use page and per_page to walk the list. Judge.me: GET /reviews.

product_id.description: Judge.me internal product id. Omit for all store reviews.

rating.description: Only reviews with this star rating (1-5).

tools.name: judgeme_count_reviews
tools.title: Count reviews
tools.description: Count reviews for the store, one product, or one reviewer, optionally filtered by star rating. Judge.me: GET /reviews/count.

product_id.description: Judge.me internal product id. Omit for all store reviews.

rating.description: Only reviews with this star rating (1-5).

tools.name: judgeme_get_review
tools.title: Get review
tools.description: Get one review by its Judge.me internal id, with its body, rating, reviewer and reply state. Judge.me: GET /reviews/{id}.

tools.name: judgeme_get_reviewer
tools.title: Get reviewer
tools.description: Get a reviewer's name and contact details by Judge.me internal id, or by email. Use it to follow up with a reviewer. Judge.me: GET /reviewers/{id}.

reviewer_id.description: Judge.me internal reviewer id. Omit to look up by email.

email.description: Reviewer email. Used when reviewer_id is omitted.

tools.name: judgeme_get_shop_info
tools.title: Get shop info
tools.description: Get the store's basic Judge.me details: plan, owner name and email, and e-commerce platform. A good first call to check the connection. Judge.me: GET /shops/info.

tools.name: judgeme_get_settings
tools.title: Get settings
tools.description: Get selected Judge.me settings for the store, by key (for example admin_email, autopublish, enable_review_pictures). Judge.me: GET /settings.

tools.name: judgeme_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks this store has registered with Judge.me, with their URLs and topics. Judge.me: GET /webhooks.

tools.name: judgeme_reply_to_review
tools.title: Reply to review
tools.description: Post a public store reply under one review on the Judge.me review widget. The reply is visible to shoppers. Each call creates a new reply. Judge.me: POST /replies.

send_reply_email.description: Also email the reviewer about the reply (default true at Judge.me).

prompts.title: Get started with Judge.me
prompts.description: What you can do with Judge.me here, with example requests to try.
